audit.why: Level chart (Aatrox 1-6, Cho'Gath at 2+ items) matches the Aatrox-side audit exactly and the packet flags no contradiction at 49.83% over 576 games — a near-even lane decided by whether Cho'Gath survives to Feast stacks.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike and cooldown text named 'The Darkin Blade' generically and called Cho'Gath's ult 'your committal tool' without a single number.
audit.why: The Darkin Blade is 14/12/10/8/6s and Umbral Dash 9/8/7/6/5s — the rank-1 to rank-5 collapse from 14s to 6s is the whole reason the lane gets worse for Cho'Gath through levels 3-5. Feast is 80/70/60s.
audit.corrected: Trade windows keyed to Q at 14s rank 1 versus 6s rank 5, Umbral Dash at 9s, and Feast at 80s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Key Ability Interactions' said only 'Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep + Q him.' — it never stated the decisive interaction.
audit.why: Rupture's knockup is a displacement that takes Aatrox out of Umbral Dash and out of a Q swing, and Feral Scream's silence stops the rest of the chain. Infernal Chains (825 range, 20s at rank 1) drags him back to the centre only if he stays in the zone — walking out of the ring beats the drag. That is the mechanical core of the matchup and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Rupture (6s flat) knocks him out of Umbral Dash and cuts the Q chain; Feral Scream silences the rest; Feast is true damage through his bruiser resists.

audit.whatIsWrong: Don'ts entry was pure filler ('Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked').
audit.why: champ-data/_kits/_missing/chogath.json flags Aatrox as a needs-antiheal matchup: Deathbringer Stance, Umbral Dash's passive heal and World Ender's heal amp all recover the chip Vorpal Spikes does. Grievous Wounds timing is the actual decision.
audit.corrected: Buy Grievous Wounds before committing to long trades.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of the Deathbringer Stance tell.
audit.why: His combo opens with an empowered auto-attack reset; the glow on the wind-up is the cue to step out, not the ability cast. Not currently anywhere in the entry, and no writable field had room for it without breaking the length band.

edits.before: Track Aatrox's The Darkin Blade: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep + Q him. When it is down — Q-W + R him.
edits.after: Rupture (6s flat) knocks him out of Umbral Dash (9s) and cuts the Q chain; Feral Scream silences the rest.

edits.before: - Aatrox The Darkin Blade: matchup-defining — Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep + Q him. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - The Darkin Blade: 14s at rank 1, 6s at rank 5 — step up after his third swing, not before it. - Umbral Dash (9s) is his escape and his heal; Rupture knocks him out of it. - Feast: 80s of true damage, kill windows only.

edits.before: Sweetspots knock up. Sidestep + Q him. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His Q is 14s at rank 1 and only 6s at rank 5 — step up after the third swing.

edits.before: Aatrox wastes The Darkin Blade — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: He burned all three Q swings — at rank 1 that is 14s. Commit everything.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: His passive heals off you — buy Grievous Wounds before long trades.

notes: MC_WR_TABLES.chogath lists aatrox at 45.03 while the audit packet reports 49.83 over 576 games. I did not touch MC_WR_TABLES (forbidden), but the two sources disagree by ~5 points and one of them is stale.
